blocks.title: Build The Future Of Energy With Us
blocks.text: We are a growing local team that takes pride in its craftsmanship. If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Renewable Energy Sales Expert
items: 2+ years of renewable energy sales experience (preferred but not required)
Located in NH or has the ability to commute to Deerfield NH
Is a go getter, has ability to manage themselves, and is willing to work on commission
Proven experience seeing a renewable energy sale from prospect all the way to install

jobs.title: Licensed Electrician
items: Licensed Electrician with 5+ years of experience
Located in NH or has the ability to commute to Deerfield NH
Is a go getter, has ability to manage themselves, and can commit to a full time schedule
Comfortable with heights, as you will be on roofs

jobs.title: Office Admin
items: Office Admin with 5+ years of experience

Is a go getter, has ability to manage themselves, and can commit to a full time schedule
